entities.title: NativeResult
entities.summary: What a JSON-layer JavaTime adapter returns when converting a UTV value to java.time: a status, the value when unique, whether the conversion was lossy, and diagnostics.
notToBeConfusedWith: Outcome, which the typed to… methods return; they turn a NativeResult into an Outcome with Typed.fromNative.
UtvResult, the utv-result/1.0 envelope of every other JSON-layer operation.

entities.title: JavaTime.As
entities.summary: The caller's intent for a java.time value with more than one reading: INSTANT, OFFSET_DATE_TIME or LOCAL_DATE_TIME.
notToBeConfusedWith: The typed layer, where the target type names the intent instead (Instant.from vs FixedOffsetDateTime.from).

entities.title: Fail
entities.summary: The package-private exception that carries a non-success outcome (status and diagnostics) out of deep decoding code; every public operation catches it and returns it as a result.
notToBeConfusedWith: OutcomeException, which is public and thrown only by Outcome.single.
